protocol.frame: hip_cz complete cases without outcomes, counts, identifiers and dropout_r
protocol.outer_splits: 5 groups of states from grouped_folds(seed=2016); each group is the test states once
protocol.acceptance: the largest change that lowers the search-fold error by more than two paired fold standard errors; otherwise the removal with the fewest terms whose cost is below 2 standard errors; otherwise stop

uncertainty.across_states: per-zone test predictions are stored, so a reader can compute standard errors that treat each state as one draw
uncertainty.across_assignments: not measured: one assignment of states to the five splits
